🎵 ODNONO Anniversary Celebration Concert in Arambol, Goa! 

Date: 📅 Sunday, January 4, 2026
Time: 🕖 7:00 PM (19:00)
Location: 📍 Arambolians, Beside, Pirata-Pizzeria, Opp Axiom Retreats, Arambol, Goa, India

This season marks an anniversary for the band ODNONO (@odnono), as it's been exactly 10 years since their first concert in Goa! That initial performance surprised them by drawing nearly 400 people. Since then, they've returned to Arambol every year for spontaneous, warm, and atmospheric concerts beneath the ancient, magical jungle. 🌳

Their shows in Goa are known for featuring musician friends from all over the world. Previous guests at their Goan "kвартирники" (house concerts) include Bittu Mallik, Sun from 5nizza, Davide Swarup, R.A.SVET, Veda Ram, Ilya Rimar, and others. 🌍🎤

What to Expect on January 4th: 🔊
 ♡ Electronic Dance Program: The first concert of the season will take place between New Year's and Old New Year's (January 4th). 🕺
 ♡ Performance: Alexey Myshkin will perform both new Odnono songs and familiar hits.
 ♡ Poetry: The band's leader will also read his newest poems set to meditative ambient music. ✨

Hey! 🙋‍♀️

Today step into the electrifying JBS Vagator *Monday Open Mic*!🎤

Join us tonight at the courtyard for a creative explosion. Express yourself with songs, poetry, and improv acts on our open stage. 

Hosted by the fabulous *Sushant* joined by a crew of talented artists, musicians, actors, rappers, percussionists, and poets, this stage has seen 500+ mind-blowing performances! Grab the mic, enjoy drinks, and dive into the vibrant atmosphere. 🕺🏻💃🏻

Join us *6:00 PM onwards* for an evening of sensational acts, yummy drinks, scrumptious food, and enchanting tunes. 🎶🎵 Let's raise a toast to art and community! 🥂
